findings.title: Missing canonical repository identity fails open
findings.detail: GoalExecution.check/5 maps a nil repositoryId to :unmanaged. AgentRunner and DeliveryCoordinator treat :unmanaged as authorization to continue, so a BOS/game_api issue whose native_ref retains issueNumber but loses repositoryId can run implementation turns and repair cycles without inheriting or checking the approved Goal authorization. This violates the repository contract that game_api issues without canonical repository identity fail closed. The test at goal_execution_test.exs:151-156 explicitly expects this unsafe result. Return an identity error/pause for malformed managed native_ref values while preserving :unmanaged only for genuinely non-BOS issues, and update coverage.

summary: Changes requested: exact-commit validations pass and the main Goal budget/window paths are covered, but malformed managed repository identity still bypasses authorization via :unmanaged.
